chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Monaco.
Monaco is a tiny, rich and beautiful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Monaco is in Western Europe.
It is on the Mediterranean Sea between France and Italy.
It is the second smallest country in the world after Vatican City.
Monaco is only two square kilometers.
What is the capital of Monaco?
Monaco does not have a separate capital city.
The whole country is one city -state, but the most famous area is Monte Carlo.
Monte Carlo is known for its casino, luxury hotels, and the Formula One race.
How many people live in Monaco?
About 39,000 people live in Monaco.
It is very small, but also very crowded.
Many people come from other countries.
Only about one in five people is a Monagasc citizen.
What language do people speak in Monaco?
The official language is French.
People also speak English, Italian, and Monagasc, a local dialect.
Many people are multilingual because Monaco is very international.
What is the weather like in Monaco?
Monaco has a Mediterranean climate, hot, dry summers, mild, rainy winters.
The weather is usually sunny and warm, perfect for the beach.
What does Monaco look like?
Monaco has hills and buildings built on cliffs, harbors full of big yachts, luxury hotels, gardens and palaces, a beautiful view of the blue sea.
There is very little space, but it is very clean and elegant.
What animals live in Monaco?
Because Monaco is small and full of buildings, there are not many wild animals.
You may see seagulls and pigeons, fish, crabs and sea birds near the harbor, pet dogs and cats.
The nearby sea is home to many fish and sea life.
What do people eat in Monaco?
Monagasc food is a mix of French and Italian cooking with Mediterranean flavors.

People eat fish and seafood, fresh vegetables and olive oil, bread, pasta and cheese, popular dishes, barbejoin, a fried pastry with rice and spinach, soccer, a chickpea pancake, also eaten in Nice, France.
Ratatouille, stewed vegetables, seafood pasta and grilled fish, tarts and pastries for dessert.
What do people drink in Monaco?
People drink water and fruit juice, coffee and tea, wine, especially from France and Italy.
In the summer, cold drinks like lemonade or sparkling water.
Eating and drinking is often done at cafes by the sea.
What is life like in Monaco?
Life in Monaco is safe, clean and very luxurious.
It is known for expensive cars, elegant clothes, rich tourists, quiet parks and high -end restaurants.
People enjoy walking by the sea, boating and swimming, shopping in fancy stores, watching sports and car races.
What are some holidays and traditions in Monaco?
National Day, November 19th, Monte Carlo Rally, a famous car race.
Monaco Grand Prix, Formula One racing in the streets.
Christmas and Easter, celebrated with lights and food.
Feast of St.
DeVote, honoring the patron saint of Monaco.
There are also many ballet, music and art events during the year.
Some fun facts about Monaco.
Monaco is ruled by a prince, not a president.
The royal family lives in the Prince's Palace.
Monaco has no airport, people arrive by car, train or helicopter.
It has the highest population density in Europe.
Monaco has no income tax for residents.
Now you know many things about Monaco.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the city, the sea and the special traditions.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili.
